description.zh:
设备信息。更多信息，请参见下文“Device定义”。

> 如果传入JobId参数，此参数不传。
description.en:
Device information. For more information, see "Device definition" below.

> If you pass the JobId parameter, do not pass this parameter.

description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must pass this ID value; otherwise, the invocation will fail.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh:
任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符。

> 如果传入Device参数，此参数不传。
description.en:
The job ID. This is the globally unique identifier of the job.

> If you pass the Device parameter, do not pass this parameter.

description.zh: 每页显示的记录数。默认值为10，最大值为50。
description.en: The number of records displayed per page. Default Value is 10, and the maximum value is 50.

description.zh:
下一页标识。首次查询可不传入值。如果存在下一页，服务会返回NextToken值，下次请求时传入。

NextToken值有效时间为1分钟。失效后，将返回对应的错误码。
description.en:
The token that identifies the next page. You do not need to pass a value for the first query. If a next page exists, the service returns a NextToken value, which you must pass in the next request.

The NextToken value is valid for 1 minute. After it expires, the corresponding error code is returned.

description.zh:
任务作业的状态。取值范围：

- **QUEUED**：待调度。
- **SENT**：已调度。
- **IN_PROGRESS**：执行中。
- **FAILED**：失败。
- **REJECTED**：已拒绝。
- **TIMED_OUT**：已超时。
- **SUCCEEDED**：已成功。
- **CANCELLED**：已取消。
description.en:
The status of the job. Valid values:  

- **QUEUED**: Pending scheduling.  
- **SENT**: Scheduled.  
- **IN_PROGRESS**: Executing.  
- **FAILED**: Failed.  
- **REJECTED**: Rejected.  
- **TIMED_OUT**: Timed out.  
- **SUCCEEDED**: Succeeded.  
- **CANCELLED**: Cancelled.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

  > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 5.

  > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot list-task --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --limit 10 --job-id sGWotgRk000010001 --next-token 22dhgg000 --status QUEUED --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot ListTask --region cn-hangzhou --Status QUEUED --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --NextToken 22dhgg000 --Device '{}' --Limit 10 --JobId sGWotgRk000010001
